tasks.label: Rust: Top 10 by Cyclomatic Complexity
args:
rust-code-analysis-cli -m -p src -O json | jq -sr '[.[] | .name as $file
 | .. | objects
 | select(.kind? == "function" and .name != null and .name != "<anonymous>")
 | {cc: .metrics.cyclomatic.sum, file: $file, line: .start_line, name}]
 | sort_by(-.cc, .file, .line) | .[:10][]
 | [.cc, "\(.file):\(.line)", .name] | @tsv'
